character_sheet: A small flat passive fish: a flat 8x1x12 body slab, a nub of a head, a two-piece tail and two side fins (ModelFlounder.java:40-62, six parts). 5 HP, speed 0.25, no attack at all (Flounder.java:65-70, ATTACK_DAMAGE 0). It drifts with the current (pushed by fluid, :73-75), flees players within 8 blocks and panics when hurt (:58-59), breeds on a crystal apple (:57, :185-187, :191-193) and, stranded, scans up to ten blocks for water and flops toward it, drying out 1 HP at a time when none is found (:86-107); in water it splashes and heals (:109-112). A water creature that spawns in daylight above y 50, at most ten together (:154-161; ModEntities.java:376-378). Read it as a flatfish: the side fins sculling, the tail sweeping, a lazy tail flick at rest.
size_notes: Drawn at x1.0 of the rig, x0.5 as a baby (FlounderRenderer.java:27, :42-43; shadow 0.1, :29) on a 64x32 sheet (ModelFlounder.java:64), flounder.png (FlounderRenderer.java:21); the hitbox is 0.55 x 0.25 (ModEntities.java:376-378).

labels.head: head (a 4x1x2 nub at the front edge; static — no look)
labels.tail1: tail, first piece (4x1x2 at the rear edge; pitches with the tail group)
labels.tail2: tail fin (6x1x3 behind the first piece, sharing its pivot; pitches with tail1)
labels.rfin: right side fin (3x1x2; rolls with the walk at its own rhythm)
labels.lfin: left side fin (3x1x2; rolls with the walk at its own rhythm)

groups.name: gait
groups.axis: z (the two fins) and x (the tail)
groups.amplitude: three rhythms above a limbSwingAmount of 0.1, each pi x 0.25 = 0.785 rad (45 deg) x the walking speed: the left fin at 1.3 rad/tick, the right fin at 1.7, both tail pieces together at 1.2; below the threshold the fins go to 0 and the tail keeps an unscaled pi x 0.05 = 0.157 rad (9 deg) flick at 0.7 rad/tick
groups.plain: the left and right fins roll up and down with the stride at two rhythms that never line up, and both tail pieces sweep together at a third; at rest the fins go flat and the tail keeps a small slow flick
groups.math: lfin.zRot = amount > 0.1 ? cos(t * 1.3) * pi * 0.25 * amount : 0; rfin.zRot = amount > 0.1 ? cos(t * 1.7) * pi * 0.25 * amount : 0; tail1.xRot = tail2.xRot = amount > 0.1 ? cos(t * 1.2) * pi * 0.25 * amount : cos(t * 0.7) * pi * 0.05
groups.phase: the limbSwingAmount threshold of 0.1 gates the fins and selects the tail's rhythm (one gait group per rig: the generator's rule, so the three walk rhythms share this group)
groups.omega_note: the classic phases are ageInTicks x 1.3 for the left fin (a 4.83-tick period), x 1.7 for the right fin (3.70 ticks) and x 1.2 for the tail (5.24 ticks); at rest the tail runs at x 0.7 (8.98 ticks)

behaviour: Three gait-scaled rhythms, each gated by a limbSwingAmount of 0.1 (ModelFlounder.java:71-81): the left fin rolls 45 degrees x the walking speed at 1.3 rad/tick and the right at 1.7 (:72-73, :78-79), so the fins never beat in step; the two tail pieces pitch together 45 degrees x the speed at 1.2 rad/tick (:80-81).

At rest the fins go flat (:75-76) and the tail keeps a 9-degree flick at 0.7 rad/tick, a 9-tick period (:80) — the only motion of a still flounder. The body and the head are static; the head does not follow the look.

The same formulas draw it in water and on land: setupAnim has no water branch, so the swim and the stranded flop toward water (Flounder.java:86-107) look alike today, scaled only by how fast it moves (speed 0.25, :41).

extras.name: splash
extras.trigger: customServerAiStep (Flounder.java:109-112): in water, on a 1-in-50 tick, GENERIC_SPLASH at a random pitch and a heal of 1; a server-side roll with no packet today — a named site (transport 3) when the rig lands
extras.note: a body flick and a tail slap on the splash

wishlist: in `swim`: a flatfish stroke — the code's fins roll at two unrelated rhythms (ModelFlounder.java:72-73) and the tail sweeps at a third (:80); a single undulation from head to tail fin with the fins trailing reads as swimming rather than flapping
in `walk`: the stranded flop (Flounder.java:86-107) — a body slap and a hop toward the water, not a stride; the walk fallback plays it on land
in `idle`: keep the tail flick (:80) and add a gill-breath rise of the body slab; a settled flounder half-buried reads better than a hovering slab
in `hurt`: a startled dart — the PanicGoal (Flounder.java:59) sends it off at 1.5 speed right after
formulas: `ModelFlounder.setupAnim` (ModelFlounder.java:68-82; orig ModelFlounder.java:67-76 in `render` (func_78088_a, :61-83; func_78087_a at :91-93 is a bare super call); no wingspeed): while the walking speed is above a tenth the left fin rolls by the cosine of the age in ticks times 1.3, times pi, times 0.25, times the walking speed and the right fin by the cosine of the age times 1.7, times pi, times 0.25, times the walking speed, else both hold 0; the two tail pieces pitch by the cosine of the age times 1.2, times pi, times 0.25, times the walking speed while the walking speed is above a tenth, else by the cosine of the age times 0.7, times pi, times 0.05. The walk position, the head angles and the entity's state play no part. The GeckoLib hook is the same (FlounderGeoReplacement.applyCustomAnimations).
